notes: System tab redesigned: search, Ready to race (kit problems show here too; shrinks to one line when all green), Screens and QR codes, Event, and a Kit owner folder with 7 pages
The ? button is for fixing problems: search the fixes, then Send a problem report
Problem reports are emailed to the kit owner from the kit's own Gmail; with no internet they wait and send later. Set up in Kit owner › Advanced
Reports leave out passwords, crew names and officials' names
